arguments.conclusion: Humans will remain the ultimate decision-makers in investing due to diverse goals and the inherent inefficiency of markets.
source_speech_filenames: 20260226_The Markets will Never Be the Same - AI Takeover.txt
arguments.premise_synthesis: Investors pursue diverse goals such as income, liquidity, and hedging, which prevent pure return maximization. The Grossman-Stiglitz paradox indicates perfect efficiency is unattainable, as it would remove profit incentives. Additionally, capital constraints prevent large investors from exploiting small opportunities, ensuring persistent inefficiency and a role for human judgment.
arguments.conclusion_supported: Humans will remain essential investment decision-makers because market inefficiency persists due to diverse investor goals, the Grossman-Stiglitz paradox, and capital constraints on large players, which AI cannot fully overcome.
